persona.name: Alex Rivera
persona.description: Synthetic final-year CS student / software engineer. All facts are fictional and authored by us for reproducible evaluation; no real user data is used.

messages.content: I'm setting up a new laptop. For context, I always code in VS Code with dark mode on, and for machine learning work I strongly prefer Python over everything else.
Got it. I'll assume VS Code with a dark theme, and Python as your go-to for ML.
Right. I also dislike verbose inline comments, I'd rather keep code self-explanatory.
Quick note about me: I'm vegetarian and I'm allergic to peanuts, so keep that in mind for any recipe suggestions.
Understood, vegetarian and peanut allergy noted.
Also every morning I go for a run and then grab an oat milk latte.
My final-year project is called UniMemory, a long-term memory layer for AI apps. The backend is built with FastAPI and uses PostgreSQL with the pgvector extension for vector search.
Nice, FastAPI + Postgres/pgvector is a solid stack for that.
The hard deadline for the final evaluation is in November.
On the side I'm building an expense-splitting app for friends called TripSplit. It's a React Native app.
Expense splitting in React Native, sounds handy for group trips.
Yeah but I'm currently stuck on the authentication flow.
I live in Mumbai now, but I'm originally from Pune. I'm a final-year student at Somaiya.
Mumbai-based, Pune roots, studying at Somaiya, got it.
I have a younger sister named Nisha.
My girlfriend's name is Maya. Our anniversary is March 12.
Maya, anniversary on March 12, noted.
She loves sunflowers, I always get her those.
I'm planning a trip to Goa from December 20 to 26 with my college friends.
Goa, Dec 20-26, with college friends, sounds fun.
Need to book the flights soon.
I'm giving a talk at PyCon in October about vector search for memory systems.
A PyCon talk on vector search, that's a great topic.
I still need to finish the slides.
Next I want to learn Rust, I keep hearing good things about it.
Rust is a great next step, especially coming from Python.
Right now I'm reading Designing Data-Intensive Applications.
I have a cat named Pixel who wakes me up at 6am every day.
Pixel the cat, 6am wake-up, noted.
I drive a blue Honda City to campus.

conversations.title: Helping a friend set up his editor

messages.content: My friend Rohan asked me to help set up his laptop. He uses IntelliJ IDEA with the light theme for his Java coursework.
Sure, IntelliJ with a light theme for Rohan's Java work, noted.
He also wants the Vim keybindings plugin turned on.
For the terminal I use iTerm2 with zsh and tmux, and I keep a split pane open for logs.
iTerm2, zsh and tmux with a log pane, got it.
My keyboard is a mechanical one with brown switches, I can't type on laptop keys for long.
During my internship I wrote Kotlin for an Android app, and honestly it felt clunky to me.
Kotlin for Android at the internship, and not a favourite, noted.
At a hackathon I used Go for a small CLI tool because it compiles to a single binary.
My cousin Kabir is visiting this weekend. He is vegan and allergic to shellfish, so I need to plan meals carefully.
Vegan and a shellfish allergy for Kabir, I'll keep that in mind.
I'm thinking dal, jeera rice and a big salad for him.
In the evening I usually have a cup of masala chai while studying.
Masala chai in the evenings, noted.
On weekends I switch to cold coffee from the cafe near the station.
Last year at a hackathon our team built ParkPal, an app to find free parking spots. We used Flask and MongoDB because it was quick to set up.
ParkPal with Flask and MongoDB, nice hackathon build.
We came second, but nobody maintains it anymore.
At my summer internship at a fintech startup I built internal dashboards in Django with a MySQL database.
Django and MySQL dashboards at a fintech, got it.
The team also used Redis for caching session data.
My classmate Priya's final-year project is CropSense, a crop disease detector. Her backend is Express with a MongoDB database.
CropSense by Priya, Express plus MongoDB, noted.
I'm helping her review the model accuracy numbers before her demo.
My personal portfolio site is built with Next.js and deployed on Vercel.
Next.js portfolio on Vercel, got it.
I also once started a Chrome extension called TabNap to auto-close idle tabs, but I abandoned it.
For UniMemory our mentor is Prof. Kulkarni, and the team is three people including me.
Prof. Kulkarni as mentor, a team of three, noted.
We still have to record the demo video and print the report.
My friend Rohan studies at VJTI and my school friend Arjun is doing his masters at IIT Bombay.
Rohan at VJTI and Arjun at IIT Bombay, noted.
Priya is in my class though, same batch.
My dad is a civil engineer and my mom teaches chemistry at a junior college.
Civil engineer dad and chemistry teacher mom, got it.
My grandparents live in Nashik and my older cousin Kabir lives with them.
My roommate has a golden retriever named Bruno, and I dog-sit him when he travels.
Bruno the golden retriever, and you dog-sit sometimes, noted.
Bruno is scared of thunderstorms, so I keep the curtains closed.
My dad drives a white Maruti Swift, and that's the car I learned to drive in.
A white Maruti Swift, your learner car, got it.
Back in school I rode a red Hero bicycle everywhere.
Once a month I take the train to Nashik to see my grandparents.
Monthly train trips to Nashik, noted.
Sometimes on the way back we stop at Lonavala for chikki.
Rohan has been dating Tara for two years. Their anniversary is July 4.
Rohan and Tara, anniversary on July 4, noted.
Tara loves orchids, so he asked me where to buy them.
Maya works as a UX designer at a design agency, and she loves Studio Ghibli films.
Maya is a UX designer and a Ghibli fan, got it.
Her birthday is on August 30, I want to plan something early this time.
Last May I went to Manali with my family and we did a short trek to Jogini Falls.
Manali last May with family, including Jogini Falls, nice.
It was freezing at night even in summer.
Priya is going to Kerala with her family for the winter break and asked me for houseboat suggestions.
Priya's Kerala trip with family, I can suggest houseboats in Alleppey.
I'm not going on that one, just helping her plan.
Next month I'm attending a local React meetup and the GDG DevFest, just as part of the audience.
React meetup and GDG DevFest as an attendee, noted.
I mostly want to network and maybe find an internship lead.
A senior from our college ran a Docker workshop last Saturday and I attended it.
You attended a Docker workshop run by a senior, got it.
I finally understood multi-stage builds.
I finished Clean Code last month but didn't enjoy it much.
Clean Code done, not a favourite, noted.
Maya recommended Atomic Habits, so that's on my someday list.
Last year I completed Andrew Ng's machine learning course on Coursera.
Andrew Ng's ML course on Coursera, nice.
These days I listen to the Lex Fridman podcast while running.
I play acoustic guitar in my free time and I'm a big Prateek Kuhad fan.
Acoustic guitar and Prateek Kuhad, got it.
On Sundays I play badminton with Rohan at the club near my place.
My semester exams start in the first week of May, and the internal viva is a week before that.
Semester exams in early May with the viva a week earlier, noted.
I need to finish the cloud computing assignments first.
I use a MacBook Air M2 for everything, and my phone is an iPhone 13.
MacBook Air M2 and iPhone 13, got it.
I also have an old Kindle that I barely use.
